svg.title: Crimson Robes in Ink · When the Wind Rises
svg.desc: A pure vector reinterpretation of the supplied illustration. Playback follows document order: gesture sketch, broad color blocking, proportion and connection revisions, tonal modeling, hair and fabric refinement, distant-scene review, and final local accents. Early construction lines remain beneath later paint, so revisions appear through covering and redrawing. No bitmap images, scripts, or external resources.
